title: Norm of a zero-one-valued function
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and suppose every value of $f$ is either $0$ or $1$. If its uniform mean is $\alpha$ and $p>0$, then its uniform $L^p$ norm is $\alpha^{1/p}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is defined on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube and is real-valued
